title: Strongly convex dynamic online optimization on a box with unknown ℓ₁ path length.
summary: One learner must adapt to all comparator paths without knowing path length in advance. Losses are strongly convex, the domain is a box, and path length uses the one-norm. Each round reveals only the gradient at the chosen action.
